backend/main.mo: Motoko actor for a home services backend that manages bookings and reviews, providing CRUD operations including add, get, update, delete, and filter by service/rating.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (BookingFormPopup modal, WhatsApp submission, Book Now buttons on service cards) to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of every frontend source file, describing each component's or page's purpose and key behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the TrustFix React app with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div that loads the Vite/React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app that sets up TanStack Router with routes for Home, Services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, Booking, Contact, and Reviews, wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: Modal booking form popup with fields for customer name, mobile, address, read-only service, property type, date, time, and notes; on submit it opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message in a new tab instead of navigating away.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: A card component for displaying a cleaning service item with an image, price badge, features list, and booking/WhatsApp CTA buttons, with intersection-observer-based fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: An auto-advancing carousel that fetches and displays featured customer reviews from the backend, with navigation controls and star ratings.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: A fixed floating button on the bottom-left that opens a WhatsApp link when clicked, styled as a green circular phone icon.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button on the bottom-right with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the TrustFix brand, contact links, a list of service categories, quick navigation links, and social media icons.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: A full-width hero banner with an overlay, headline, tagline, and two CTA buttons that open WhatsApp for booking or calling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around page content, and scrolls to the top on route changes.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, a service search dropdown with results, and a WhatsApp call button.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: A card component for painting services that uses IntersectionObserver for scroll-based fade-in animation, displays service image, price, features, and star rating, and provides WhatsApp and Book Now action buttons.
A card component for pest control services displaying an image, price badge, features checklist, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, service label, star rating, review text, and formatted date derived from a nanosecond timestamp.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: A generic service card with scroll-triggered fade-in animation, showing service image, price, features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons; used primarily for pest control services.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Renders a grid of service category cards with scroll-triggered animations, fallback image cycling, and click navigation to the services page filtered by category.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: A reusable star rating display component that supports optional interactive rating selection and configurable star size and count.
A card component for service subcategories with scroll-triggered fade-in, displaying image, price, features, and Get Quote/Book Now buttons that open WhatsApp or trigger a booking callback.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
A form component that lets users submit reviews with name, service type, star rating, and review text, using a mutation to call the backend actor and invalidating review queries on success.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for all service categories (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.) including pricing, images, and features, plus WhatsApp contact utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity.
Custom hook that exposes a mutation for submitting a booking to the backend actor, then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login, logout, and identity state across the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports three React Query hooks (useGetFeaturedReviews, useGetAllReviews, useGetAllBookings) that fetch data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that filters and returns up to 8 deduplicated service search results from the static services data based on a query string.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins/Inter fonts, sets up Tailwind layers with CSS custom properties for theming (light/dark), and defines custom animations and component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: A booking form page that collects user details (name, phone, service, property type, date, time) and sends the booking information to a WhatsApp number via a pre-filled message URL.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact page displaying TrustFix's phone, WhatsApp, address, email, and working hours as clickable cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The homepage composing the hero section, trust badges, service grid, 'Why Choose Us' features, reviews carousel, and a WhatsApp CTA banner.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: A reviews page that fetches all reviews from the backend actor via React Query and displays them in a grid alongside a write-review form.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: A services page that shows a category selection grid or a detailed service listing based on URL search params, supporting booking popups and WhatsApp links.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom brand colors, fonts (Inter, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and animations like fadeInUp and wave.
project_state.json: Tracks the TrustFix website project state (version 3), describing the goal of adding a Book Now popup booking form with WhatsApp integration to all subcategory service cards, along with architectural notes and implemented feature records.
